trackingIdForImport.description: This ID is used to determine which import this entity belongs to.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

source.description:
The {@link File} which has the original diagrams in either a pdf or an image. Notice that
multiple {@link ParsableDiagram} can reference to the same single-page or multi-page pdf.

imageFile.description:
To parse a diagram, it has to be in an image format that can be consumed by downstream
computer vision routines. If {@link source} is not an image file, then this field will
contain a reference to an image-field version of {@link source}. If {@link source} is already
an image, this field will be the same as {@link source}.

sourceDiagram.description:
The {@link SourceParsableDiagram} which has the original source of diagrams in either a pdf or an image.
Notice that multiple {@link ParsableDiagram} can reference to the same {@link SourceParsableDiagram}.

pidNumber.description: pid number, default to p&id file name, might be duplicate if p&id have multiple pages

extracts.description:
Upon parsing the {@link imageFile}, the results will be stored in a {@link ParsedDiagramExtract}.
The {@link imageFile} may be parsed several times with different algorithms. All of the
{@link ParsedDiagramExtract}s are accessbile from this field.

latestExtract.description: Latest {@link ParsedDiagramExtract} created for this diagram.

latestExtractSensorCount.description: Latest {@link ParsedDiagramExtract}'s sensor count created for this diagram.

assets.description: Collection of {@link ParsedAsset}s extracted by parsing the diagram.

sensors.description: Collection of {@link ParsedSensor}s associated with all the `extracts` of this diagram.

connectedAssetRelations.description: {@link PhysicalAsset} relations associated with this diagram.

lastUpdate.description:
Information about the last tracked update to the P&ID done by a user.
Tracked updates include:
  verifying/unverifying {@link ParsedSensor}s,
  adding/deleting {@link ParsedSensor}s,
  connecting {@link PhysicalAsset}s

parsingStatus.description:
The status of diagram parsing for this diagram. If the diagram was uploaded without triggering the parsing job,
then the status will be set to {@link DiagramParsingStatus#NOT_PARSED}.
When the parsing job starts each diagram is updated with a status of {@link DiagramParsingStatus#IN_PROGRESS}.
Once the parsing job finishes, each diagram is updated with a status of {@link DiagramParsingStatus#PARSED}.

displayStatus.description: A translated representation of {@link ParsableDiagram#parsingStatus} to be used in the UI.

title:
Represents an industrial engineering diagram such as P&ID. For details on other information
stored in this Type, refer to the documentation on each of the fields of this Type.
name: ParsableDiagram
